selection_reasons.household_solver: Modified Howard was the fastest passing household option in the reported comparisons.
selection_reasons.invariant_distribution: Power iteration with sparse CSR was the fastest passing distribution option in the reported comparisons.
selection_reasons.asset_range: k_max=5 is the smallest tested range with zero top-node mass and contains the distribution's support.
selection_reasons.grid_family: Its mean Euler error is lower (0.001089 versus 0.001204), and its distribution-weighted mean error is substantially lower (0.000805 versus 0.001472). I accept its higher overall maximum error.
selection_reasons.final_N: N=5000 gives the lowest mean, maximum, and distribution-weighted Euler errors among the tested grids, with a runtime of about 4.36 seconds.
